regions.region: left-column graphical abstract, title, abstract, and introduction
regions.finding: The graphical abstract is a generic summary of the double 1,2-addition scope and standard conditions; it was not duplicated as a completed experiment. Abstract and cited prior-work summaries were treated as context.
Generic R-group map of possible 1,2-addition, 1,4-addition, and double-bond-migration products; classified as a general scheme, not as verified present-paper experiments.
Distinct Fe(acac)3-catalyzed 1a-to-2a experiment extracted with 3 equiv allylmagnesium chloride, toluene, -78 °C, 1.5 h, 85% isolated yield, and absence of the 1,4-addition product.

unresolved: Scheme 1 contains generic R groups and supplies no experiment-specific quantities or yields.
Equation 1 omits scale, solvent volume, atmosphere, workup, and purification.

regions.finding: Four independent temperature/solvent optimization entries extracted with row-specific time and NMR yield. The page-1 prose explicitly supplies 0.4 mmol scale and 5 mL THF only for standard entry 3.

regions.region: middle-left Table 2, reaction drawing, and footnotes
regions.finding: Nineteen independent substrate-scope rows extracted. Shared 0.4 mmol allenoate, 3 equiv 1.7 M allylmagnesium chloride in THF, THF 5 mL, room temperature, row time, and isolated yield were retained; footnote a overrides entries 10 and 18 to 2 mmol, and footnote b identifies 1r as methyl 2,3-butadienoate.

Three distinct reported experiments extracted: bis-allenoate 3 to 4 (82%, dr approximately 1:1), optically active 1c to 2c (90%, 98% to 97% ee), and 1i with 2-methylallylmagnesium chloride to 2s (98%).

Six substrate/reagent-specific tests retained separately: three allylic Grignards and vinylmagnesium chloride gave complicated mixtures, while methyl- and phenylmagnesium chloride gave related conjugate-addition products. No numeric yields were invented.

unresolved: Most table rows omit atmosphere, workup, and purification; abbreviated rows were not assigned the complete 2a procedure.
Equations 2 and 4 do not state yield basis; equation 2 lacks complete source-safe candidate structures.
The six alternative Grignard tests omit most quantities and exact product identities.

regions.finding: Four reaction arrows were identified. The 2i-to-5, 2i-to-6, and 2i-to-7 experiments are recorded on this page; the 7-to-8 RCM record also cites page 4 for its detailed batch.

The complete 2a batch was merged into Table 2 entry 1, adding exact masses/amounts, nitrogen atmosphere, TLC monitoring, workup, chromatography, product mass, and 94% isolated yield. Materials statements were used only where tied to a recorded experiment.

regions.region: lower-left and right-column procedures for products 5, 6, and 7
regions.finding: Detailed quantities, operations, workups, purifications, masses, and isolated yields were merged into the corresponding Scheme 2 arrow records. Scheme times of 2 h, 48 h, and 11 h were retained.

unresolved: Atmosphere is not stated for the iodocyclization, palladium allylation, or silver cyclization.
Complex products 5–8 were retained by source label/name without asserted candidate SMILES.
The product-7 characterization continues onto page 4 and is not a separate reaction.

regions.finding: Analytical characterization continuing from page 3 supports product 7 identity but does not define a new reaction.

regions.region: left and upper-right columns, detailed RCM preparation of 8
regions.finding: The 7-to-8 Grubbs-II RCM arrow was enriched with printed masses/mmol, 5 mol% catalyst, CH2Cl2 volume, N2 atmosphere, reflux for 2 h, concentration, flash chromatography, 32.5 mg product, and 86% isolated yield.

regions.region: right-column acknowledgments and Supporting Information notice
regions.finding: No new reaction. The paper states SI availability, but no SI file was supplied or explicitly associated, so the dataset association remains unestablished.

unresolved: The printed 41.8 mg/0.2 mmol quantity for substrate 7 is internally inconsistent with the reported product mass/yield and was preserved without correction.
SI association remains unestablished; no SI-only conditions or spectra were imported.
